title: YIELD: no pass figure exists; the evidence is a 19-ULP and a 6-ULP divergence
status_plain: YIELD has no pass-rate figure anywhere in OxFunc. What it has is divergence: about 19 ULP on the stream's own witness, where OxFunc's bisection returns 0x3fb61465bd6a9970 against Excel's 0x3fb61465bd6a9983, and 6 ULP on the par witness in the tracked recon corpus. The structural defect -- YIELD returning #NUM! on a well-posed bond -- was fixed on build 20026 and the numeric residual was reclassified onto the catalogue's NUM-L lane, where it remains. Any per-surface YIELD pass figure would be a fabrication. In particular the 15/15 and 10/10 printed inside YIELD's own catalogue row are PRICE data scoring a candidate; they are recorded in EV-FIN-0022 and may not migrate here.

The residual after the forward fix is characterised as plateau publication: corrected PRICE is flat at exactly 95 across a roughly 20-ULP yield band and Excel publishes one specific point inside it. The stream's own "Fixed in ref" field reads `not yet fixed`.
reader_warning: There is no YIELD pass rate. Both data points are divergences. The 15/15 and 10/10 printed inside YIELD's own catalogue row belong to PRICE and score a candidate model; see EV-FIN-0022. Any figure attributed to YIELD other than the two divergences here is fabricated.
